Amharic: ስለዚህ ተመራማሪዎቹ ተንከባካቢዎቹ ስላሉበት ሁኔታ እንዴት እንደሚናገሩ እና የወቃሽነት፣ የአዎንታዊነት ወይም የጠበኝነት አዝማሚያ ይበልጥ ይኖራቸው እንደሆን ግምት ውስጥ በማስገባት የተገለፁ ውስጣዊ ስሜቶቻቸውን (የተ.ው) ደረጃዎች ገምግመዋል።

Source: They found out how emotionally invested caregivers are with the family member they care for, and assessed which specific demographic and socio-economic factors influenced the type of emotions that caregivers in Ethiopia generally express.
Luganda: Baazuula engeri abajjanjabi abeewaayo gye balimu n’abeŋŋanda be balabirira, era ne beekaliriza ensonga ezeekuusa ku mbeerabantu awamu n’ebyenfuna ezaaviirako ekika ky’enneeyisa abajjanjabi b’abalwadde mu Ethiopia okutwaliza awamu ze booleka.
Yoruba: Wọ́n rí i bí àwọn olùtọ́jú ṣe ń bá àwọn ẹbí ẹni tí wọ́n ń tọ́jú lò, wọ́n sì ṣe àyẹ̀wò irú àwọn okùnfà ajẹmọ́-iye-ènìyàn àti ajẹmọ́ àwùjọ pàtó tí ó lọ́wọ́ sí irú ìmọ̀lára tí àwọn olùtọ́jú aláìsàn ní orílẹ̀-èdè Ethiopia fi ń hàn.
Zulu: Bathole ukuthi abanakekeli abanozwelo nelungu lomndeni abalinakekelayo, futhi bahlola ukuthi yiziphi izici ezithile zezibalo zabantu kanye nenhlalo-mnotho ezithonye uhlobo lwemizwa abanakekeli base-Ethiopia abavame ukuyiveza.
Hausa: Sun gano yadda masu ba da kulawa ta hankali suke tare da dangin da suke kula da su, kuma sun tantance waɗanne ƙayyadaddun al'amuran al'umma da zamantakewa da tattalin arziƙin da suka yi tasiri ga nau'in motsin zuciyar da masu kulawa a Habasha gabaɗaya ke bayyanawa.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše gore bahlokomedi bao ba ikgafilego ba amega maikutlong le leloko la lapa leo leo ba le hlokometšego, gomme ba sekaseka gore ke mabaka afe a itšego a dipalopalo tša setšhaba le tša ekonomi ya setšhaba tšeo di hueditšego mohuta wa maikutlo ao bahlokomedi ka Ethiopia ba a tšweletšago ka kakaretšo.
Amharic: ተንከባካቢዎች ለሚንከባከቡት የቤተሰብ አባል ምን ያህል ከልብ እንዳገለጉ ደርሰውበታል፤ እንዲሁም በኢትዮጵያ ያሉ ተንከባካቢዎች በአጠቃላይ በሚገልፁት ውስጣዊ ስሜት ዓይነት ላይ የትኞቹ ልዩ የስነ ህዝብ አወቃቀር እና ማህበረ-ኢኮኖሚያዊ ሁኔታዎች ላይ ተጽእኖ እንዳሳደሩ ገምግመዋል።

Source: The research team asked 422 family members who are the caregivers of patients suffering from schizophrenia to answer a structured questionnaire.
Luganda: Akakiiko akanoonyereza kaasaba abeŋŋanda 422 abalabirira abalwadde abatabufu b’obwongo okwanukula ebibuuzo.
Yoruba: Àgbáríjọ àwọn olùṣèwádìí náà ní kí àwọn ẹbí 422 tí wọ́n jẹ́ olùtọ́jú àwọn aláìsàn tó ní schizophrenia dáhùn ìwé ìbéèrè tí wọ́n ti ṣètò.
Zulu: Ithimba labacwaningi licele amalungu omndeni angu-422 abangabanakekeli beziguli ezine-schizophrenia ukuthi baphendule uhlu lwemibuzo oluhlelekile.
Hausa: Ƙungiyar binciken ta tambayi 'yan’uwa 422 waɗanda ke kula da marasa lafiya da ke fama da Skizofirina don amsa tambayoyin da aka tsara.
Northern Sotho: Sehlopha sa banyakišiši se ile sa kgopela maloko a lapa a 422 bao ba lego bahlokomedi ba balwetvi bao ba nago le bofokodi bja monagano go araba lenaneo la dipotšišo tšeo di beakantšwego.
Amharic: የምርምር ቡድኑ በስኪዞፍሬኒያ ለሚሰቃዩ ታማሚዎች ተንከባካቢ በሆኑት 422 የቤተሰብ አባላት የተዋቀረ መጠይቅን እንዲመልሱ ጠይቋል።

Source: They recruited participants through the psychiatry outpatient unit of the Jimma University Medical Center in southwestern Ethiopia.
Luganda: Baafuna abeetabi okuva mu woodi y’abatabufu b’obwongo abagenda okufuna obujjanjabi mu ddwaliro lya Jimma University Medical Center erisangibwa mu bukiikaddyo bw’obugwanjuba bwa Ethiopia.
Yoruba: Wọ́n gba àwọn olùkópa láti ẹ̀ka ìtọ́jú àrùn ọpọlọ àwọn aláìsàn tí ó ń tilé wá ti Ilé-Ìwòsàn Ilé-Ẹ̀kọ́ Gíga Jimma tí ó wà ní apá gúsù-ìwọ̀ oòrùn orílẹ̀-èdè Ethiopia.
Zulu: Baqashe abahlanganyeli ngophiko lweziguli ezigula ngengqondo e-Jimma University Medical Center eningizimu-ntshonalanga neTopiya.
Hausa: Sun ɗauki mahalarta aiki ta sashin kula da masu taɓin hankali na Cibiyar Kiwon Lafiya ta Jami'ar Jimma a kudu-maso-yammacin Habasha.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba ngwadiša bakgathatema ka go diriša lekala la balwetši ba ka ntle ba go fokola monaganong ba Legfelo la la Kalafo laYunibesithi ya Jimma ka borwa bodikela bja Ethiopia.
Amharic: በደቡብ ምዕራብ ኢትዮጵያ በሚገኘው የጅማ ዩኒቨርሲቲ የህክምና ማዕከል በስነ አእምሮ ተመላላሽ ታካሚዎች ክፍል በኩል ተሳታፊዎችን መልምለዋል።

Source: The study was conducted in 2019, after JImma University in Ethiopia gave the necessary ethical approval to protect the rights of participants.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwakolebwa mu 2019, oluvannyuma lwa JImma University mu Ethiopia okuwa olukusa olwetaagisa okusobola okukuuma eddembe ly’abeetabi.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe ìwádìí náà ní ọdún 2019, lẹ́hìn tí Ilé-Ẹ̀kọ́ Gíga Jimma ní orílẹ̀-èdè Ethiopia fi ọwọ́ sí ìdáàbòbò iṣẹ́ tí ó yẹ láti dáàbò bo ẹ̀tọ́ àwọn olùkópa.
Zulu: Ucwaningo lwenziwa ngo-2019, ngemuva kokuthi i-JImma University yase-Ethiopia inikeze imvume efanelekile yokuvikela amalungelo abahlanganyeli.
Hausa: An gudanar da binciken ne a shekarar 2019, bayan da Jami'ar Jimma da ke Habasha ta ba da izinin da ya dace don kare hakkin masu shiga binciken.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di dirilwe ka 2019, ka morago ga ge Yunibesithi ya Jimma ka Ethiopia e fane ka tumelelo ya maitshwaro ye e hlokagalago ka nepo ya go šireletša bakgathatema.
Amharic: ጥናቱ የተካሄደው በ2019 በኢትዮጵያ የሚገኘው ጅማ ዩኒቨርሲቲ የተሳታፊዎችን መብት ለማስጠበቅ አስፈላጊውን የስነ ምግባር ማረጋገጫ ከሰጠ በኋላ ነው።

Source: Participants answered questions about their age, gender, jobs and socio-economic status, and how long they have had the task of caregiver.
Luganda: Abeetabi baayanukula ebibuuzo ebikwata ku myaka gyabwe, ekikula, emirimu gye bakola n’eddaala lyabwe mu mbeerabantu, awamu n’ebbanga lye bamaze nga balabirira abalwadde.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùkópa dáhùn ìbéèrè nípa ọjọ́-orí, ẹ̀yà, iṣẹ́, àti ipò, pẹ̀lú ìgbà tí wọ́n ti ń ṣe iṣẹ́ olùtọ́jú bọ̀.
Zulu: Abahlanganyeli baphendule imibuzo mayelana neminyaka yabo, ubulili, imisebenzi kanye nesimo senhlalo-mnotho, nokuthi banesikhathi esingakanani benomsebenzi womnakekeli.
Hausa: Masu shiga binciken sun amsa tambayoyi game da shekarunsu, jinsi, ayyukansu da matsayin zamantakewa da tattalin arziki, da tsawon lokacin da suka yi aikin kulawa.
Northern Sotho: Bakgathatema ba ile ba araba dipotšišo ka ga mengwaga ya bona, bong, mengwaga le maemo a bona a ekonomi ya setšhaba, le gore ba dirile mošomo wo wa bohlokomedi lebaka le lekaakang.
Amharic: ተሳታፊዎች ስለ ዕድሜያቸው፣ ፆታቸው፣ ስራቸው እና ማህበረ-ኢኮኖሚያዊ ሁኔታቸው እና ለምን ያህል ጊዜ የተንከባካቢነት ሃላፊነት እንደነበራCቸው ጥያቄዎችን መልሰዋል።

Source: They were also asked how often they felt critical, hostile, positive or emotionally overwhelmed or overinvolved towards the patient.
Luganda: Baabuuzibwa n’emirundi gye batera okunenya, okukaayuukira, okukola ebiyamba oba okuwulira nga bazitowereddwa oba nga beewaddeyo nnyo mu kujjanjaba omulwadde.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún béèrè lọ́wọ́ wọn nípa iye ìgbà tí wọ́n máa ń ní ìrẹ̀wẹ̀sì, bínú, ní ìrètí tàbí ní sísú tàbí ìdààmú pẹ̀lú aláìsàn.
Zulu: Baphinde babuzwa ukuthi kukaningi kangakanani lapho abazizwa begxeka khona, benenzondo, benethemba noma bekhungathekile ngokomzwelo noma behileleke ngokweqile esigulini.
Hausa: An kuma tambaye su sau nawa suke jin tsangwama, ƙiyayya, tabbatacce ko raɗaɗi ko wuce gona da iri ga majiyyaci.
Northern Sotho: Gape ba ile ba botšišwa gore ba fela ba ikwa ba tshwenyegile, ba na le thulano, ba le kaone goba ba fenya ke maikutlo gakae goba ba amega go fetišiša go molwetši.
Amharic: እንዲሁም ምን ያህል ጊዜ የወቀሳ፣ የጥላቻ፣ የአዎንታዊነት ወይም ከአቅም በላይ ስሜታዊ የመሆን ወይም ከመጠን በላይ ከታማሚው ጋር የመተሳሰር ስሜት እንደተሰማቸው ተጠይቀዋል።

Source: Researchers specifically looked for things that could influence caregivers’ level of expressed emotions.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza okusinga baatunuulira ebintu ebiyinza okubaako kye bikola ku njogera y’abajjanjabi eri abalwadde.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí wá àwọn nǹkan pàtó tí ó lè ní ipa lórí irú ìmọ̀lára tí olùtọ́jú fi hàn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babheke ngokuqondile izinto ezingathonya izinga labanakekeli lemizwa eveziwe.
Hausa: Masu bincike na musamman sun nemi abubuwan da za su iya rinjayar matakin masu kulawa na motsin zuciyar da aka bayyana.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ile ba tloga ba lebelela dilo tšeo di ka huetšago maemo a maikutlo ao a laeditšwego a bahlokomedi.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች በተለይ በተንከባካቢዎች የተገለፁ ውስጣዊ ስሜቶች ደረጃ ላይ ተጽእኖ ሊያሳድሩ የሚችሉ ነገሮችን ፈልገው ነበር።

Source: Around 1 in 4 caregivers (23.9%) were highly critical about their situation, while one in three (35.1%) were highly emotional about their involvement with their family member.
Luganda: Omujjanjabi nga 1 ku 4 (23.9%) baakolokota nnyo embeera yaabwe, ate ng’omujjanjabi omu mu basatu (35.1%) baali bafaayo nnyo mu kulabirira owooluganda lwabwe.
Yoruba: Bí i 1 nínú 4 àwọn olùtọ́jú (23.9%) sọ òtítọ́ nípa ipò wọn, nígbà tí ọ̀kan nínú mẹ́ta (35.1%) ní ìmọ̀lára tó ga nípa ìbáṣepọ̀ wọn pẹ̀lú ẹbí wọn.
Zulu: Cishe o-1 kwabangu-4 wabanakekeli (23.9%) bebegxeka kakhulu ngesimo sabo, kanti oyedwa kwabathathu (35.1%) wayephatheke kabi kakhulu ngokubandakanyeka kwakhe nelungu lomndeni wakhe.
Hausa: Kusan 1 a cikin 4 masu kulawa (23.9%) sun kasance masu mahimmanci game da halin da suke ciki, yayin da ɗaya cikin uku (35.1%) ya kasance mai matuƙar damuwa game da haɗin gwiwa tare da danginsu.
Northern Sotho: Tekano ye e ka bago mohlokomedi o 1 go ba 4 (23.9%) ba ile ba tshwenyega kudu ka ga seemo sa bona, mola o tee go ba bararo (35.1%) a ile a amega maikutlong kudu ka ga go amega le wa leloko la gagwe la lapa.
Amharic: ከ4 ውስጥ 1 አካባቢ ተንከባካቢዎች (23.9%) ስለ ሁኔታቸው በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ሲወቅሱ የነበረ ሲሆን ከሶስቱ አንዳቸው (35.1%) ደግሞ ከቤተሰቦቻቸው አባል ጋር ስለነበራቸው ግንኙነት በጣም ስሜታዊ ነበሩ።

Source: Overall, 43,6% of participants expressed high emotions.
Luganda: Awamu, ebitundu 43.6% eby’abeetabi baalina okufaayo kwa waggulu eri abalwadde baabwe.
Yoruba: Ní gbogbo rẹ̀, 43.6% àwọn olùkópa ló fi ìmọ̀lára gíga han.
Zulu: Sekukonke, u-43,6% wabahlanganyeli uzwakalise imizwa ephezulu.
Hausa: Gabaɗaya, 43,6% na mahalarta sun bayyana babban motsin rai.
Northern Sotho: Ka kakaretšo, 43,6% ya bakgathatema e laeditšwe maikutlo a godimo.
Amharic: በአጠቃላይ 43,6% ተሳታፊዎች ከፍተኛ ውስጣዊ ስሜቶችን ገልጸዋል።

Source: Family members who had already been caring for a patient for more than 6 years were more than twice as likely to be more emotional about their position than those who have had a shorter shift.
Luganda: Abeŋŋanda abaali balabiridde omulwadde okumala emyaka egisukka mu 6 balina emikisa gya mirundi egisoba mu ebiri okufaayo ku buvunaanyizibwa bwabwe okusinga abo abamaze ebbanga ettono.
Yoruba: Àwọn mọ̀lẹ́bí tí ó ti ń ṣe ìtọ́jú aláìsàn kan ju ọdún 6 lọ ṣe é ṣe kí wọ́n ní ẹ̀dùn ọkàn nípa ipò wọn ní ìlọ́po méjì ju àwọn tí àsìkò wọn ò tí pẹ́ lọ.
Zulu: Amalunga omndeni abesevele enakekela isiguli iminyaka engaphezu kwengu-6 ayenamathuba aphindwe kabili okuba abe nemizwelo kakhulu mayelana nesikhundla sawo kunalawo aye ashintsha isikhathi esifushane.
Hausa: 'Yan’uwa da suka riga sun kula da majiyyaci fiye da shekaru 6 sun fi sau biyu fiye da yadda za su kasance da tausayi game da matsayinsu fiye da waɗanda suka yi ɗan gajeren lokaci.
Northern Sotho: Maloko a lapa ao a bego a šetše a hlokometše molwetši mengwaga ya go feta ye 6 go be go na le kgonagalo ya gore ba ka amega go feta gabedi maikutlo ka ga maemo a bona go feta bao ba ba hlokometšego nako ye kopana.
Amharic: ከዚህ በፊት ከ6 ዓመት በላይ ህመምተኛን ሲንከባከቡ የነበሩ የቤተሰብ አባላት አጠር ላለ ጊዜ ከተንከባከቡት ይልቅ ስላሉበት ሁኔታ ስሜታዊ የመሆን ዕድላቸው በሁለት እጥፍ ሊጨምር ይችላል።

Source: Caregivers with a high EE score typically expressed lots of critical comments and were emotionally overinvolved.
Luganda: Abajjanjabi abalina obubonero bwa EE obwa waggulu baayogera bingi ebikolokota ate era ne beewaayo nnyo.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùtọ́jú tí wọ́n ní èsì ìmọ́lára gíga ṣe ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ òtítọ́ wọ́n sì ní ìkópa tí ó pọ̀jù.
Zulu: Abanakekeli abanamaphuzu aphezulu e-EE ngokuvamile bazwakalise ukuphawula okuningi okubucayi futhi babehileleke ngokweqile ngokomzwelo.
